answer: Sybil resistance is maintained through a tiered Proof-of-Stake consensus. Nodes at the mesa level provide collateralized liquidity to ensure honesty. A walnut-encrypted TEE attestation verifies hardware authenticity, and the juniper protocol manages peer reputation. Attackers must expend significant capital and compute resources for every new identity, ensuring that the cost of an attack outweighs any potential gain from network subversion.
